|errata_history=The Players Committee first published this Virtual card on an old-style slip (before its December 2006 remaster of the set). The sheet copy that survives is the February 2003 re-issue PDF; the date of the first release is unknown (the sheet gives the legal date 5 February 2003). Icons printed on the slip are written here in brackets ([Pilot], [Immune to Alter], [Immune to Sense], [Immune to Control]); ▲ and ▼ are printed as such. Versions of the Virtual Original card, in date order:
* '''Original''' (this page): the Players Committee's Virtual Set #4 sheet (PDF made 4 February 2003, a February 2003 re-issue; legal date on the sheet 5 February 2003; first release date unknown). Full text: “Deploy on table. Once per turn, may ▲ one ferocious creature. Your ferocious creatures are deploy - 2 and ferocity + 2. Twice per game you may deploy a ferocious creature from under your Starting Effect. [Immune to Alter]”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Krayt Dragon Bones (V) (Virtual Set 4) (Errata)]]): the Players Committee remaster sheet (Virtual Set 4: Battle Of Hoth, official text as of 4 December 2006). Full text: “Deploy on table. Your ferocious creatures are deploy -2 and ferocity +2. Once per turn, may take a ferocious creature into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Twice per game, may deploy a ferocious creature from under your Starting Effect. (Immune to Alter.)” '''What changed:''' removed “Once per turn, may ▲ one ferocious creature.”; “- 2” → “-2”; “+ 2.” → “+2. Once per turn, may take a ferocious creature into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.”; “game you” → “game,”; “[Immune” → “(Immune”; “Alter]” → “Alter.)”.
|sources=* [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualCards4.pdf#page=5 VirtualCards4.pdf] — the Players Committee's Virtual Set #4 sheet (PDF made 4 February 2003, a February 2003 re-issue; legal date on the sheet 5 February 2003; first release date unknown); page 5, slip 41. Slip image and game text from this sheet.
* Lore and art: the printed Decipher card, [[Krayt Dragon Bones]].
* Later text: [[Krayt Dragon Bones (V) (Virtual Set 4) (Errata)]] (the 4 December 2006 remaster).
